open_questions: Chunk range: the brief gives 0x804a6b0 as the end, but the manifest's last function at 0x0804a6e4 (size 33) ends at 0x804a704 and is included; the merge lane should confirm the boundary (0x804a6c0 _start is in this chunk).

150 PLT import thunks have no source body (status=translated, naming=observed). The merge lane should decide whether callers referencing these addresses are rewritten to the import name; several import names are C++ mangled (_ZNSs..., _Znaj, _ZdlPv) and their signatures use void * for std::string objects.

Out-of-chunk placeholders used by this chunk: fn_0804a750 (CRT frame_dummy), fn_0813e2e0 (CRT ctor driver), fn_0813e230 (CRT init), fn_0813e290 (CRT fini), fn_080d4f7c (main, pushed as __libc_start_main's main argument). Their names are inferred from the crt1/crti/crtbegin convention, not from strings.

Ghidra pseudocode for call_gmon_start shows an unconditional call to __gmon_start__ and for PLT0 a null-pointer call; both are artefacts. The reconstruction follows the disassembly (weak null test; push/jmp pair).
